name: scapewatch-companion
description: Read-only Chrome extension companion for ScapeWatch: passively observes the game and hosts Gauntlet Lab in the side panel

scripts.build:lab: cd gauntlet_lab && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/copy-lab.js
scripts.test: node --test extension/readonly-policy.test.js extension/redact.test.js extension/parsers/*.test.js standalone/*.test.js standalone/vision/*.test.js
